ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast ratio with approximately 65% high-intensity white pixels on lobe surfaces and 35% low-intensity black pixels concentrated at the peduncle junction and perimeter.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white segments occupy the central lobes. A dark, roughly triangular low-intensity region extends from the peduncle toward the median notch. The white fields are interrupted by high-frequency dark linear pixels and irregular black mottling along the trailing edges.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with a calculated angle of approximately 50-60 degrees and a high-depth bounding box relative to lobe width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous jagged boundary with high-amplitude irregular peaks at the distal tips and moderate-frequency serrations along the trailing edge of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curve extending from the median notch towards the mid-lobe, transitioning to a sharper convex curve at the outer distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Highly textured, dark, irregular pixel clusters present at both distal tips, indicating localized protrusions or barnacle colonization sites.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Dense network of multi-directional dark linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) crossing the white ventral fields, with a higher concentration of parallel lines on the left lobe (viewer perspective).

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular edge degradation and heavy dark scarring at the distal tips of both lobes, suggesting previous trauma or extensive parasitic attachment.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique cross-hatched rake mark pattern on the mid-left lobe and a prominent dark vertical streak near the inner right trailing edge.
